svg.text: Private Network Service Platform: Phase 1 Topology
Client opens https://app.solo.test → our own DNS → HTTPS edge (TLS ends here) → round-robin to Backend A or B. Team domain: solo.test
Shared Wi-Fi LAN 10.7.0.0/19 (mask 255.255.224.0) · gateway 10.7.0.1 · interface en0 on every Mac · ping TTL 64 = no router in between (same LAN segment)
Mac 2 and Mac 3 act as clients (Wi-Fi DNS = 10.7.7.5)
Never an IP address; no -k, CA is trusted
Config: dns/dnsmasq.conf · caffeinate keeps it awake
Mac 2 and Mac 3: Wi-Fi DNS set to 10.7.7.5
TCP 443 → TLS 1.2 / 1.3 + HTTP/2 (ALPN). TLS ends here
Issuer: solo Local Root CA (created on this Mac)
AWS ALB / CDN edge · config nginx/solo.conf
GET / · GET /api/status (no-store, shows A or B)
Binds 0.0.0.0 so other Macs can reach it
Log says from=10.7.21.121: sees the edge, not client
Wireshark capture point (en0) for Task G
Two EC2 instances in a target group
TCP 3-way handshake: client :60675 → Mac 2 :443 (SYN, SYN-ACK, ACK)
TLS 1.2 handshake: Client Hello (SNI + ALPN h2) → Certificate → Finished
HTTP/2 GET /api/status Host: app.solo.test (encrypted on the wire)
Encrypted HTTP/2 reply: 200 + X-Backend (nginx re-applies TLS)
Application · UDP 53 · answer is just an IP
Application · chosen by ALPN inside TLS
Every step rides on IP (Network layer) and Ethernet / Wi-Fi (Link layer)
inside one /19 LAN: frames go straight to the target Mac's own MAC.
Client never learns backend IPs: DNS points at the edge, the edge chooses.
1 Mac 2 creates the root CA “solo Local Root CA” (CA:TRUE)
2 Mac 2 signs the server cert: CN app.solo.test, SAN app + api
3 Only rootCA.pem (public) is AirDropped to Mac 1 and Mac 3
4 Installed in the System keychain of all 3 Macs: Always Trust
5 rootCA.key and server.key never leave Mac 2
6 Client check: “SSL certificate verify ok”, demo never uses -k
7 TLS 1.3 hides the Certificate, so the capture forced TLS 1.2
step 6 · nginx retries, all replies B
Diagnose bottom-up: DNS → IP → TCP → TLS → app
Captured in Wireshark on Mac 3: DNS 49943 → 53 · SYN 60675 → 443 (Seq 0) · TLS 1.2 Client Hello + Certificate · encrypted Application Data · plain-HTTP leg shows X-Forwarded-For: 10.7.26.163
